findings: components[1].sound_limitation.text: Replace “original pronunciation” with a narrower limitation. The cited Zhengzhang and Baxter–Sagart comparisons report Old Chinese readings for both 快 and 夬, supporting their sound relation, while the evidence leaves uncertain the proposed pictorial referent and the pronunciation of any name for that object. Cite the comparison evidence and retain the distinction from 夬’s early lexical reading (X-1f066a340b3a716497e5, X-45233f5c5648ed14bc54, X-c3cdc3cf3ceec6a1405b, X-6cf790e75f19f70113a0).
